parsed_jd.summary: Join us as a Full Stack Developer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence.
responsibilities: Design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
Harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

professional_summaries: Software Development Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and full-stack applications across enterprise and startup environments. Strong expertise in API design, data modeling, and performance optimization, with hands-on experience designing transaction-safe and real-time systems. Proficient in developing high-performance, production-grade architectures using Node.js, MongoDB, and cloud platforms, with a focus on scalability, consistency, and clean system design. Proven ability to own features end-to-end and build reliable, scalable systems in production.

Mendix Developer with 2.5+ years of hands-on experience and 4+ years of overall professional experience building enterprise-scale applications across logistics, compliance, and transport domains. Strong expertise in Mendix domain modeling, microflows, security, integrations, workflow automation, and UI/UX using Atlas Design System, with a solid full-stack foundation in JavaScript, REST APIs, and cloud platforms. Proven ability to own features end-to-end, collaborate with global stakeholders, and support production systems in regulated enterprise environments, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions across low-code and pro-code architectures

responsibilities: Designed and developed enterprise-scale applications across backend and frontend, optimizing state management, data flow, and UI performance for complex workflows.
Architected backend integrations and REST API layers for scalable communication across services
Built systems with role-based access control (RBAC), auditability, and secure data flows.
Owned features end-to-end, from requirement design and development to production deployment and post-release ownership.
